hypothesis: Revenue, margins, ROA and ROE rise sharply
evidence: Revenue 5,010 -> 215,938; operating margin 15% -> 62% (2024); ROE 14% -> 92% (2024). Not a smooth rise: dips in 2019 (operating margin 26%) and 2022 (16%).
Current ratio between 2.57 and 8.03 in every year.

Z' below 2.90 (grey zone) in 2015, 2020, 2021, 2022; lowest 1.96 in 2022. Causes: revenue/assets (X5) below 1 until 2024, and retained earnings cut by retiring bought-back shares (12,026 in 2021, buybacks 10,039 in 2022), so X2 fell from 0.80 (2018) to 0.21 (2022).

hypothesis: Very high ROE can reflect buybacks as well as profit
evidence: DuPont 2024: net margin 0.56 x asset turnover 1.17 x equity multiplier 1.41 = ROE 0.92. Multiplier only 1.31-1.86, so ROE is driven by profit; buybacks were large (33,706 in 2024, 46% of net income) but equity still grew 42,978 -> 79,327.

hypothesis: Weak profitability and thin equity in the early years
evidence: Losses in 2015-2016 (net income -660, -497); equity -412 (negative) in 2015, debt-to-equity 6.98 in 2016; Z' -1.03.
Revenue 4,272 (2016) -> 34,639 (2025); debt-to-equity fell to 0.22; Z' rose above 1.23 in 2020 (2.21) and stayed in the grey zone or above.

hypothesis: Xilinx (2022) raises assets and goodwill, lowering ROA and asset turnover
evidence: Total assets 12,419 -> 67,580; goodwill 289 -> 24,177; asset turnover 1.32 -> 0.35; ROA 25% -> 2%. Z' fell 3.02 -> 2.29 through X5, without any distress.
Capex 7,326 (13% of revenue, 2015) -> 25,750 (47%, 2023) while revenue fell from 79,024 (2021) to 54,228; buybacks stopped (0 in 2022-2023, no line after).
Total liabilities 41,083 -> 91,453 (2024), but debt ratio stayed 0.40-0.47 because equity also grew; debt-to-equity peaked at 0.92 (2024).

hypothesis: Leverage and coverage worsen before profit collapses
evidence: Coverage fell 32.6 (2021) -> 4.7 (2022) -> 0.11 (2023), one to two years before the 2024 loss; Z' < 1.23 from 2023. The fall came from operating income (19,456 -> 2,334 -> 93), not interest (496-878). Leverage gave no warning (debt ratio never above 0.6).
Net loss in all 11 years (2015 -64 to 2025 -1,609); operating margin negative every year, -175% in 2025.
Debt ratio 0.17 (2015) -> 0.75 (2023) -> 1.07 (2025); debt-to-equity 8.05 (2024); equity negative in 2025. Low until 2022.
Coverage negative in every year (operating losses), e.g. -1.81 in 2024; 2015-2019 use cash interest paid as a proxy.

Current ratio 3.29-5.74 in 2015-2024 (still 4.51 in 2024), then 0.36 in 2025, when the 10-K presented its long-term borrowings as current because of the missed interest payment, the restructuring agreement and the defaults triggered by the Chapter 11 filing.
Chapter 11 petition 30 June 2025 (fiscal year end 29 June 2025); emerged 29 September 2025 with fresh-start accounting. Series ends at 2025.
